participant_id.Description: sub-<3-digit source patient number>; the source numbers patients 1-110 (no suitable channels for 51, 86, 95, 105).

source_patient_id.Description: Patient number exactly as in the source (Patient variable / PatientInformation.csv ID).

age.Description: Age at time of study (source PatientInformation.csv)

site_code.Description: First character of the source channel names (recording-centre code; power line 50 Hz for G, 60 Hz for M and N per source readme). The source does not name the centres.

atlas_hemispheres.Description: Hemisphere(s) of this patient's atlas channels, from the Hemisphere column of Information/ChannelInformation.csv of the MNI Open iEEG Atlas release (one row per atlas channel; only channels in normal tissue are included in the atlas); comma-separated.

atlas_electrode_types.Description: Electrode types of this patient's atlas channels (Electrode type column of Information/ChannelInformation.csv of the MNI Open iEEG Atlas release (one row per atlas channel; only channels in normal tissue are included in the atlas)); comma-separated codes, A = AdTech intracerebral, D = DIXI intracerebral, G = AdTech subdural strips/grids, M = MNI homemade intracerebral (code meanings per the source readme).

atlas_n_channels.Description: Number of rows for this patient in Information/ChannelInformation.csv of the MNI Open iEEG Atlas release (one row per atlas channel; only channels in normal tissue are included in the atlas). Equals the rows of the subject's electrodes.tsv in this dataset (checked).
